title: Iterate length bound from slack
statement: Let $g$ be a map on finite bit strings and let $c,b$ be natural numbers with $2\le b$ and $c+1\le b$. Suppose that for every bit string $s$, the length of $g(s)$ plus $c$ times the length of the second component's first projection in $g(s)$ is at most the maximum of $2$ and the corresponding quantity for $s$. Then for every bit string $w$ and natural number $i$, the length of the $i$th iterate of $g$ from $w$ is at most $b(|w|+1)$.
